description:
This video shows Tulum International Airport, Mexico's newest gateway, which welcomes over one million visitors every year installing 224 Samsung 360 Cassette fan coil units throughout the terminal, providing real-time, zone-by-zone cooling control.

Q: How does Samsung 360 Cassette help manage cooling in large airport spaces?
A: Samsung 360 Cassette fan coil units provide flexible zone-by-zone cooling control, making them well suited for large public spaces with high ceilings, open layouts, and continuously changing passenger traffic. Each unit adapts precisely to shifting load conditions, ensuring efficient energy management at all times, from boarding gates to lounges.

A wired touch controller on every indoor unit enables on-site monitoring and instant adjustments. The system learns and evolves with every hour of operation.
